Daowu Wuzhen owns the retained deployment: holds up the sutra's all-wisdom pure and without duality or division, then its word that no dharma can be said is called preaching, and asks where in all this the dragon-palace ocean-treasury was fetched from, and after a long silence opens the eye of heaven and earth with the three essentials, one tune without partiality vaulting past and present.

Fenyang Shanzhao owns the retained deployment: turns the formula on the White Horse, asking the assembly where an eared foreign monk arriving now should put the question of the founder's coming, since when the sutras were carried by the White Horse, what question would serve, and whether saying is permitted or not, for if not permitted, the dragon palace and ocean treasury came by horse all the same, and whether founder and teaching are one or two no counting can hold, with Baizhang's word that a buddha is beyond measure.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T48/T48n2016.xml). Record of the Mirror of the School. Yongming Yanshou owns the retained deployment: rules in the Mirror of the School that this gate the ten-direction buddhas witness and speak alike is one dharma-gate unchanging through past and present, that no buddha-land exists where its tathagata does not preach this, and that outside the Mirror no dharma can be said, since every worded teaching never leaves the even nature and is never two.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X70/X70n1403.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Tianru Weize. Tianru Weize owns the retained deployment: grants the faceless fellow who steps out crying no, that in the even true dharma-realm there is no buddha and no being, fundamentally no dharma to say and no speaker either, and that calling it a buddha slanders the buddha and a dharma to say slanders the dharma, then confesses that at this point he truly cannot sort it out, saying is not allowed, not-saying is not allowed, and with a thousand buddhas ahead even a mouth is only fit to hang on the wall, before lowering his voice that Shakyamuni has come and is judging the matter atop his staff.

Tianyin Yuanxiu owns the retained deployment: at the Yunyang layman He's feast for his two sons, says he has said all he can and again has no dharma to say, so look at the staff-head where Great Compassion sits upright, preaching that those to be delivered by a layman's body are shown a layman's body and those to be delivered by boy or girl are shown boy or girl, and asks what dharma is being said, capping it with a verse praying the two sons turn out gold and jade.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J36/J36nB359.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Baiyu. Baiyu Jingsi owns the retained deployment: tells the assembly for his nephew Miwen, who made the long trip to Bianfeng to request the dharma, that to say there is a dharma to teach buries the old sages, and to say there is no dharma to teach betrays the cousins, so after all how to say it just right, pointing them to the moon over Plum Mountain that always lights ten thousand homes in spring.

Senses.Explanation: The line that empties the buddha's forty-nine years, and the masters who quote it and then hand the audience a staff. Daowu Wuzhen holds up the sutra's all-wisdom pure and without duality, then its word that no dharma can be said is called preaching, and asks where the dragon-palace ocean-treasury was fetched from, opening heaven and earth's eye with the three essentials, Fenyang Shanzhao turns the formula on the White Horse that carried the sutras here, asking whether saying is permitted or not, since if not permitted, the dragon palace and ocean treasury came by horse all the same, and whether founder and teaching are one or two no counting can hold, Yongming Yanshou rules that outside the Mirror of the School no dharma can be said, because every worded teaching never leaves the even nature, and Tianru Weize grants the faceless fellow who cries that fundamentally no dharma can be said and no speaker either, that calling it a buddha slanders the buddha, then confesses that at this point he truly cannot sort it out, with a thousand buddhas ahead even a mouth is only fit to hang on the wall. Tianyin Yuanxiu, asked for word at a layman's feast, gets as far as he can and says there is again no dharma to say, so look at the staff-head where Great Compassion sits preaching in a layman's body, Shiyu Mingfang rules that reading silence-as-preaching and no-dharma-as-true-preaching is a view only fit for an abbot's servant, and puts his wooden seat to the assembly to name which canon it is preaching now, Fushi Tongxian opens the grave-sweeping day declaring Bao'en fundamentally has no dharma to say, the stewards asked him only to meet the season, so last night he wrote a poem and this morning hauls it out to fill the bill, and Baiyu Jingsi tells his nephew's assembly that to say there is a dharma to teach buries the old sages, to say there is no dharma to teach betrays the cousins, so how to say it just right, pointing them to the moon over Plum Mountain that always lights ten thousand homes.
